newsitem.title: GREECE: ENDYSI POSTS 33PCT H1 PROFIT GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: ENDYSI POSTS 33PCT H1 PROFIT GROWTH.

text.p: Small-cap Endysi posted a 33.7 percent rise in first half pretax profit to 195 million drachmas compared to 145 million in the same period a year earlier on turnover growth of 29.9 percent to 947 million.
Endysi is the commercial arm of Sportsman , the brand sportswear, footwear and cosmetics distributor.

Management forecast 1997 results will exceed earlier estimates stated in the company's IPO prospectus, with pretax earnings reaching 400 million drachmas, against an IPO estimate of 360 million, on turnover of 2.0 billion drachmas.
Endysi's shares were quoted at 700 drachmas, down 17, at mid-session on Friday. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
